nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; written in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spending allowances; written in approve/transferFrom.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Privileged owner address assigned to msg.sender in the constructor; gates init, delegate, batchSend, setTradeAddress and is whitelisted in ensure.
Whitelisted trading address set by setTradeAddress; bypasses the sale-limit check in ensure.
Mapping(address => uint256) counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Mapping(address => bool) whitelist that lets an address bypass the ensure() sale-limit restriction.
Minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) configured in init and enforced in condition.
Maximum number of sales allowed per address, configured in init and enforced in condition.
Token name set in the constructor.
Token symbol set in the constructor.
Constant 18 decimals used to scale supply and sale limits.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address that receives an unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Initializes name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom: checks allowance, calls ensure(), updates balances with unchecked subtraction/addition and increments _onSaleNum.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Internal whitelist gate: allows owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses to skip the condition() sale limits.
Internal sale-limit validator using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b), executing arbitrary code with this contract's storage.
Owner-only configuration of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only mass distribution: computes total = _value * _tos.length and transfers to each recipient.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Pure helper that computes the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address for the token/WETH pair.
Caller-controlled address used as owner candidate, token owner and authorisation subject throughout the contract.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() executes untrusted code in the context of this contract's storage.
Unchecked allowance decrement performed with raw arithmetic instead of SafeMath.
Raw unchecked balance subtraction in transferFrom, guarded only by a require on the current balance.
Raw unchecked balance addition in transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication computing the total batchSend amount, potentially overflowing.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Target address parameter of the delegatecall in delegate().
Calldata bytes parameter forwarded to the delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount in batchSend.
New trade whitelist address parameter.
Minimum sale amount parameter of init.
Maximum sale amount parameter of init.
Allowed sales-per-address parameter of init.
Locally computed Uniswap pair address used in the ensure() whitelist comparison.
Local total amount computed in batchSend as _value * _tos.length.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, permanently granting the deployer privileges used by all owner-only functions.
msg.sender supplies the initial totalSupply balance and the allowance grant inside the constructor.
Constructor writes balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply.
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
Constructor sets the totalSupply from the _supply argument.
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom.
transfer simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decremented with raw unchecked arithmetic.
balanceOf[_from] is decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] is incremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to succeed before moving balances.
_from parameter is used for allowance, balance and _onSaleNum lookups and updates.
_to parameter is the recipient of the balance credit.
_value parameter drives allowance and balance arithmetic.
approve stores the allowance under msg.sender as owner.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
ensure whitelists the owner address, bypassing all sale-limit checks.
ensure reads canSale[_from] to let arbitrary whitelisted addresses bypass the sale limits.
ensure whitelists tradeAddress, bypassing the sale-limit restriction.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist check.
ensure stores the computed pair address in the local _UNI variable used for the whitelist comparison.
The _UNI local determines whether _from is treated as a privileged bypass address.
When the caller is not whitelisted, ensure requires condition(_from, _value) to pass.
condition rejects transfers below _minSale.
condition rejects transfers above _maxSale.
condition uses _saleNum as the per-address sales cap.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
delegate executes a.delegatecall(b), running arbitrary external code that can re-enter and mutate this contract's storage.
The parameter `a` is the callee address of the delegatecall, allowing execution of arbitrary contracts.
The parameter `b` is the arbitrary calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before reconfiguring sale limits.
init writes _minSale from the token argument.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken argument.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum argument.
init scales the sale limits using the decimals constant.
token parameter sets the minimum sale amount.
maxToken parameter sets the maximum sale amount.
saleNum parameter sets the per-address sales cap.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass-transferring tokens.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend decrements the sender balance and credits each recipient balance in the balanceOf mapping.
The local total holds the amount deducted from the sender's balance.
_tos array supplies the recipients iterated over by batchSend.
_value supplies the per-recipient amount and the multiplication operand in batchSend.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before changing the whitelist.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress that ensure() treats as privileged.
addr parameter becomes the new whitelisted tradeAddress.
pairFor is invoked with the constant UNI router address to derive the token pair.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _from is only meaningful as the source-address input of the transferFrom function and should be folded into it.
Parameter _to is only meaningful as the recipient input of the transferFrom function and should be folded into it.
Parameter _value is only meaningful as the amount input of the transferFrom function and should be folded into it.
Parameter a is the callee address of the delegatecall and is only meaningful inside delegate().
Parameter b is the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall and is only meaningful inside delegate().
Parameter _tos is the recipient array iterated only by batchSend and should be folded into it.
Parameter _value is the per-recipient amount used only by batchSend and should be folded into it.
Parameter addr is only used to write the tradeAddress state variable inside setTradeAddress.
Parameter token is only used to compute _minSale inside init.
Parameter maxToken is only used to compute _maxSale inside init.
Parameter saleNum is only assigned to _saleNum inside init.
Local _UNI is derived and consumed solely inside the ensure() whitelist check and should be folded into it.
Local total is the direct product of the unchecked multiplication operation and should be folded into that unsafe operation.
